Status: Wave 299 accepted (6.3): the Class834 domain, start and range frame

Method.evidence: Class834 formats itself as Type=0 DoA={0} Start={1} Range={2} from c(), b(), a() and the metadata return types settle every pair: c() returns Knx.Falcon.DomainAddress and a(DomainAddress) writes it, b() returns Knx.Falcon.IndividualAddress with the matching IndividualAddress setter, and a() returns System.Byte with the byte setter. The type also has the family byte[] factory.
Method.themes: The getter return type is the last pairing key: when both sides are known, formatter order names the field and the type confirms the setter. Remaining: Class938 (formatter prints only the constant SBC) and Class871 (four packed 16-bit fields); the Class868-style result-code actions of Class854 also remain.
